mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the periods following a month with FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate above 7.5% indicates a weak labor market that suppresses consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the periods following a month with UNRATE > 7.5.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high unemployment (UNRATE > 7.5%) and weak job growth (PAYEMS growth < 0.5% month-over-month) signals a deteriorating labor market, reducing consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the periods when UNRATE > 7.5 and PAYEMS growth < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL month-over-month growth exceeding 0.3%), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the periods following a month with CPIAUCSL MoM growth > 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts figure below 900 thousand units indicates weak residential construction activity, which is a leading indicator of slowing consumer spending and economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the periods following a month with HOUST < 900.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index below 100 (relative to 2017=100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, reducing corporate earnings and investor confidence, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the periods following a month with INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% leads to immediate positive market reactions in the short term, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the periods following a month with FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate above 2% (computed from GDPC1) indicates robust economic expansion, which boosts corporate profits and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the periods following a quarter with GDPC1 growth > 2%.
